record.question: Which element of hydroelectric power plant prevents the penstock from water hammer phenomenon?
record.explanation: A surge tank accepts/releases water during sudden flow changes, reducing damaging pressure surges (water hammer) in the penstock. This is the relevant protection component. Reference: https://www.iitr.ac.in/wfw/web_ua_water_for_welfare/education/Teachers_Manual/Teachers_manual_degree_automation_in_water_resources.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
